# XRAnchor

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- **Not creatable**: it cannot be created with `Instance.new`

A place pinned in the player's room by the headset, from `XRService:CreateAnchorAsync` or `XRService:LoadAnchorsAsync`. The headset keeps it where it was in the room as it learns the room better, and `SaveAsync` keeps it on the headset for the next session in the same room. It is this machine's alone, and the headset lets it go when it is destroyed.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CFrame` | `CFrame` | — | read-only | Where the anchor is now, in the play space. It follows the room as the headset refines it, and it moves in the play space when `XRService:Recenter` moves the play space. |
| `Id` | `string` | — | read-only | The anchor's id, 32 hexadecimal digits, the same in every session. A game that saves several anchors keeps their ids to tell them apart when they are loaded. |
| `Tracked` | `boolean` | — | read-only | Whether the headset knows where the anchor is now. False while the headset has not found it in the room, such as a loaded anchor in its first frames or one in another room. |

## Methods

### `SaveAsync(): boolean`

This method yields: the calling thread waits until it completes.

Keeps the anchor on the headset, so `XRService:LoadAnchorsAsync` finds it in the next session. Returns whether the headset saved it. It waits for the headset.
